Customer Scenarios
1

Customer submits an online booking

Most common path — form on homepage → email alert → you confirm
  1. Customer fills out the Book a Service form on your homepage (name, phone, email, service, description, preferred time) and hits Submit.
  2. You receive an email alert at your owner email with the customer's details and job description.
  3. Open Admin → Service Requests tab. You'll see the request tagged Pending. Call or text the customer to discuss the job and agree on a time.
  4. Once agreed: click Mark contacted to log the call, then Confirm booking to lock it in. Or click Decline if the job isn't a fit.
  5. Confirmed bookings immediately appear in the Bookings tab under Today or Upcoming.
  6. After the job is done: find the booking and click Mark completed — it moves to Past.
Service Requests tab — pending request awaiting your confirmation
Bookings tab — confirmed jobs sorted into Today, Upcoming, and Past
2

Customer calls you directly

Skip the form — log a phone booking straight into your schedule
  1. Customer calls (706) 244-8550. You discuss the job and agree on a time.
  2. Open Admin → Bookings tab → click Record phone booking (top right).
  3. Fill in their name, phone, service, date/time preference, and any job notes → Save.
  4. Booking appears in your schedule immediately — no email flow needed.
  5. After the job: Mark completed.
Record phone booking — enter details from the call and save directly to your schedule
3

Customer chats with the AI widget

AI answers common questions automatically — you follow up on warm leads
  1. Customer opens the chat bubble on your site, enters their name (and optionally a phone number), and starts asking questions.
  2. The AI answers automatically — pricing, services, service area, availability — based on your current services and FAQs. No action needed from you in real time.
  3. Open Admin → Chat Inquiries to review conversations. New ones are tagged New.
  4. Click View transcript to read the full conversation.
  5. Call or text the customer, then click Mark contacted to close the loop. Delete chat removes it from your list.
Tip: The AI reads your Services and FAQs from the admin panel in real time. Keep those tabs up to date and the AI will always give accurate answers — no code changes needed.
Chat Inquiries — review AI conversations and follow up by phone
After a Job — Update Your Site
4

Add a job photo to the gallery

Shows in "Our Work" on homepage
  1. Admin → Gallery → + Add photo.
  2. Upload the photo and give it a short label (e.g. "Cabinet Install").
  3. Photo appears on your homepage immediately — newest first.
Gallery — 6 photos currently live
5

Add a before & after transformation

Shows in the B&A section on homepage
  1. Admin → Before & After Tasks → + Add task.
  2. Upload a before photo, an after photo, add a title, location, and short description.
  3. Card appears on homepage — most recent first.
Before & After — 3 transformations currently published
Keep Content Fresh
6

Update your services

Appears on homepage AND is read by the AI chat in real time
  1. Admin → Services tab — shows all published services in order.
  2. Click Edit on any service to change its title, description, or icon. Click + Add Service to add a new one.
  3. Changes save immediately and appear on your homepage. The AI chat widget reads these automatically — customers will get updated answers without any code changes.
Services — 5 services currently published; changes feed the homepage and AI chat
7

Update FAQs

Appears on homepage AND is read by the AI chat in real time
  1. Admin → FAQs tab — 6 questions currently published.
  2. Click Edit to change any question or answer. Use + Add FAQ to add a new one.
  3. The AI chat reads your FAQ answers verbatim — if a customer asks something the AI used to get wrong, add or fix the FAQ and it corrects immediately.
FAQs — edit answers here and the AI chat picks them up automatically
Site Settings & Access
8

Change your hero photo, phone, or email

Admin → Settings
  1. Admin → Settings tab.
  2. Hero image — click Choose File → select a photo (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5 MB) → Upload here. Or Reset to default to go back to the original.
  3. Phone number — update here if it ever changes. Shows in the site header on every page and is used by the AI chat.
  4. Owner email — where your new-booking alert emails go. Keep this current or you'll miss requests.
  5. Click Save settings.
Settings — hero photo, phone number, and email in one place
9

Add or remove admin access

Admin → Users · Google sign-in only
  1. Admin → Users tab.
  2. To add someone: enter their Gmail address, an optional display name, choose Admin (full access) or Member (view only) → Add user.
  3. They sign in at admin.sample-handyman.com with that Google account — no password to share.
  4. To remove access: click Delete next to their name.
Note: The Super Admin account (creativecoderstech@gmail.com) is protected and cannot be edited or removed.
Users — add or remove Google accounts that can access admin
